product_metadata.title: La Crosse Alerts Mobile 926-25101-GP Wireless Monitor System Set with Dry Probe
features: Remotely monitors sensors 24/7 using a APP. Perfect for...Backyard temperature and humidity; Plants, gardens and greenhouses; Refrigerators, freezers; Food storage; Sensitive electronics; Outdoor pets and livestock; and so much more
Temperature and humidity measures: (1) Ambient air temperature; (2) Ambient humidity; (3) Probe temperature, Temperature range: -40°F to 140°F
Includes: sensor, internet gateway with LAN cable & AC adapter, DRY probe
Text and E-mail Alerts first 3 months FREE; 1 year subscription available after for $11.88 yearly ($0.99 per month), kindly refer the user manual given below for troubleshooting steps.
description: For proper set up follow the below steps 1. Connect gateway to router. 2. Insert power cord into outlet and into the gateway. 3. Wait for 4 red blinks 4. Optional: Insert Probe into sensor. 5. Insert 2 AAA batteries into sensor. (Dated 2025 or newer) Observe correct polarity. 6. Download La Crosse Alerts Mobile App.

details.Included Components: Wireless temperature and humidity sensor (5.23 H x 0.76 W x 1.44 D inches) with a 6ft detachable dry probe (measuring ambient air temperature, humidity) . Also included Internet Gateway (4.75 H x 1.50 W x 1 D inches) with LAN cable and AC adapter.
